data.narrative:
Axelera AI is a Series C-stage semiconductor company founded by Fabrizio Del Maffeo that has raised $450M+ to date. The valuation analysis is grounded in a comparable universe of 11 firms—3 public (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private—all operating in the chips and semiconductors sector at similar stages of development.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $450M total raised proxy, implying a $765M valuation. Peer-median analysis draws on three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Etched ($5.0B), d-Matrix ($2.0B), and DEEPX ($529M). The median of this set is $2.0B, with a range spanning $529M to $5.0B. This dispersion reflects material variance in capital efficiency and market positioning within the cohort.

The two methods produce a triangulated valuation range of $650M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.4B. The gap between stage-progression ($765M) and peer-median ($2.0B) reflects uncertainty in whether Axelera commands typical peer multiples. Key drivers of valuation within this range include: actual revenue traction relative to capital deployed, architectural differentiation in the AI accelerator market, and customer concentration risk. The wide peer range ($529M–$5.0B) underscores that stage alone does not determine valuation in this sector; operational metrics and go-to-market progress will be material to final pricing.
